failure.exception: RuntimeError: S5 original/flip support mass differs
failure.observed_mass_delta: not printed by the v2 guard and therefore not asserted
failure.root_cause: The S5 runner required absolute original/flip fractional support-mass equality within 1e-6 after float32 128-to-14 area reductions. Horizontal flip changes floating-point reduction order, so mathematically symmetric support can differ by multiple float32 ULPs. The runner failed to reuse the previously proven four-ULP scale-aware mass-symmetry contract from geometry-v3 correction commit 24f374fcce9100b0a56d2a85c562eb10d1fdf058.

additional_prelaunch_blocker.description: The independent S5 auditor also mixes float32 generator ranks with float64 reproduced SKELEX ranks under a 1e-12 correlation identity guard; this auditor-only defect must be corrected before any successor launch.

authorized_correction.runner: Reuse the proven per-candidate four-float32-ULP mass-symmetry tolerance with four-epsilon absolute floor, retain exact original/flip candidate validity and positive-support gates, and record maximum delta/tolerance ratio.
authorized_correction.auditor: Cast all independently reproduced rank vectors to numpy.float32 before aggregation and correlation so the auditor exactly reproduces generator arithmetic.
